model: DSZ15DZMOD-3x80A MID three-phase energy meter (Modbus RTU)
applies_to: Eltako DSZ15DZMOD-3x80A MID bidirectional three-phase DIN-rail meter (art. no. 28380516), per Modbus-RTU protocol specification V1.6.
summary: The DSZ15DZMOD is Eltako's MID-approved bidirectional three-phase energy meter for direct connection up to 80 A, with an RS485 Modbus RTU interface. Values are 32-bit integers sent high word first: voltages, currents, power factors and import/export energy (total and partial) with fixed decimals.

addressing.note: Each row gives a 3xxxx/4xxxx reference and a hex start address; the hex value is the wire address (30073 = 0x0048). The manual's example frame CC 04 00 48 00 04 reads total import and export energy at 0x0048.

source.title: Modbus-RTU protocol specification for DSZ15DZMOD V1.6 (English version)
source.pages: Transmission p. 1; frame examples pp. 1-2; value table and remarks p. 3; parameter table p. 3

notes: Word order: the spec says multi-register data runs from the lower to the higher register address with each register high byte first, and its energy example answers 00 00 01 CD 00 00 01 70 for 4.61 kWh import and 3.68 kWh export, so 32-bit values are ABCD.
Scaling (remark 1): all values except power and power factor are unsigned with 2 decimals; power factor is signed with 3 decimals.

Left out: L1/L2/L3 and total active power (0x000C-0x0010, 0x0034). The remark says power is signed 'without decimal' while the unit column says kW, which would mean whole kilowatts; the resolution is too unclear to publish.
Left out: the serial number at 0xFC00 (BCD).
Measured values are read with function 04, parameters with function 03 and written with function 16. The spec's examples also use slave address 00 in place of the meter address.
The parameter table marks the baud-rate and stop-bit rows read only; only the Modbus address is listed as read/write.
The parameter rows are typed only as 'int' with no sign stated; they are listed as INT32, and all documented values are small positive numbers.

registers.name: Total import active energy
registers.description: The manual's example reads 0x000001CD = 4.61 kWh here.

registers.name: Modbus address
registers.description: 1-250; the manual's example writes 0x2A with function 16.

registers.name: Pulse output mode
registers.description: Default 2; read with function 03 in the manual's example.

integration.summary: Read input registers (function 04) at 0x0000-0x0063 for voltages, currents, power factors and energy; each value is 2 registers, high word first. Total import energy is at 0x0048 in 0.01 kWh.
integration.enable: The spec does not describe enabling Modbus. Change the Modbus address by writing register 0x0014 with function 16 (the spec's example sets 0x2A).
quirks: Hex start addresses are wire addresses.
Power-factor registers are signed with 3 decimals; other values unsigned with 2 decimals.
setup: 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit.
gotchas: There is no published power resolution; use energy deltas if you need power.
Partial energy registers are separate from the totals; do not mix them up.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
